image.name: Saavi Energía
image.description: Saavi Energía is a Mexico-based power-generation and gas-infrastructure platform serving wholesale, commercial and industrial electricity users and gas-services customers. The platform operates more than 3.7 GW across six combined-cycle plants, one solar plant, three gas-compression stations, three mobile turbines and a 40-mile pipeline. Actis formed Saavi from the InterGen México business in 2018 and sold 100% of the platform to Global Infrastructure Partners in August 2021 through GIP's emerging-markets infrastructure program. GIP remains the current legal owner. On April 27, 2026, GIP signed an agreement to combine Saavi with Grupo México power assets; if it closes, Grupo México would own 70% and GIP 30%. No legal closing was identified through August 23, 2026.

image.name: STRATOS
image.description: STRATOS is a direct-air-capture and geologic-sequestration infrastructure project in Ector County, Texas, owned through a joint venture between Occidental and a fund managed by legacy BlackRock Diversified Infrastructure. Occidental develops and operates the project through 1PointFive and consolidates the venture; BlackRock is the active noncontrolling infrastructure investor and committed $550 million at entry in November 2023. The facility is designed to capture up to 500,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide per year and use three permitted Class VI wells for permanent saline sequestration. Public sources do not disclose the owners' exact economic percentages, the BlackRock fund name, a separate STRATOS headquarters, or a legal commercial-operation date. No sale or signed ownership transfer was found through August 23, 2026.

image.name: CAG Holdings
aliases: CAG Holdings / The New Terminal One at JFK
The New Terminal One at JFK
image.description: CAG Holdings is Carlyle's U.S. airport infrastructure platform associated with The New Terminal One at John F. Kennedy International Airport. The related project company, JFK NTO LLC, is developing, financing, constructing and will operate a roughly $9.5 billion, 2.6 million-square-foot international terminal with 23 gates under a long-term Port Authority lease. Carlyle originally held a 51% indirect project interest; at financial close on June 10, 2022, Ferrovial acquired 96% of that position and Carlyle retained approximately 2% indirect ownership. Ferrovial's 2026 SEC materials report the current project split as Ferrovial 49%, Carlyle 2%, JLC Infrastructure 30% and Ullico Infrastructure 19%. CAG remains the manager-level PortCo; JFK NTO LLC and the terminal are the associated project rather than separate PortCos. No later Carlyle full exit or signed divestiture was found through August 19, 2026. CAG's platform-level stake, precise legal entry date and current headquarters are not publicly disclosed.

image.description: Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities, LLC (AIO) owns and manages land and ground leases beneath digital, renewable-energy and transportation/electrification infrastructure in the United States, including telecom, data-center, fiber, billboard, wind, solar, storage and EV-charging or logistics sites. The business was founded in 2016 and launched its dedicated CBRE Investment Management-backed infrastructure-site strategy in December 2022. Accelerate Investment Partners began operating as AIO on March 9, 2026 without a change to the platform, team or strategy. On May 7, 2026, AIO closed a $630 million primary raise that added Mubadala and Australian Retirement Trust capital and brought total equity commitments to approximately $1.26 billion. CBRE IM reported more than 450 sites across 47 states by July 2026. CBRE IM remains the sponsor and Mubadala is a current platform-equity co-investor; their exact percentages and complete legal vehicle mapping are not publicly disclosed. No later platform sale, exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.

image.name: Vantage Data Centers
image.description: Vantage Data Centers develops, owns, manages and operates hyperscale data-center campuses for cloud, AI, internet and large-enterprise customers. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Denver, the global platform includes substantial United States and Canadian operations. This canonical record consolidates direct platform equity and manager-level North American co-investments while treating Vantage SDC as a stabilized 12-asset North American portfolio managed and operated by Vantage rather than as a separate company. DigitalBridge has held platform equity since the March 2017 acquisition and led the closed $9.2 billion 2024 recapitalization with Silver Lake. CBRE participated first in pre-SDC platform equity and then in the current Vantage SDC portfolio; DigitalBridge separately retains a 12.8% SDC interest. Pantheon Infrastructure plc has a current $34.7 million North American co-investment, GCM Grosvenor retains its disclosed growth-platform exposure, and PSP exited the North American and EMEA development platforms in 2024 while disclosing a residual Vantage interest. Exact post-2024 platform percentages, most vehicles, CBRE's SDC percentage, Pantheon's closing date and PSP's residual layer are not publicly disclosed. No signed Vantage sale or later ownership transfer was identified through August 23, 2026.

image.name: Novva Data Centers
image.description: Novva Data Centers is a CIM Group-backed U.S. wholesale and colocation data-center platform serving hyperscale, cloud, artificial-intelligence and enterprise customers across the western United States. The company was founded in 2020 with funding from CIM and Novva's founders, received an additional US$355 million of CIM growth equity in 2022 and announced US$2 billion of new financing with CIM in 2025. Novva announced on November 29, 2023 that it had acquired the 400 Paul Avenue campus in San Francisco and now markets the site as Novva Data Centers–San Francisco. The campus had been acquired by a CIM/1547 joint venture in August 2017, entered construction in April 2018 and was marketed at approximately 24 MW before Novva's acquisition; Novva currently markets 36 MW on the 7.5-acre site. The seller, exact Novva closing date, retained CIM/1547 site economics and independently verified commissioned capacity are not publicly disclosed. CIM remains the current manager-level sponsor of Novva; its fund, vehicle and ownership percentage are not public. 400 Paul is an underlying facility and alias rather than a separate PortCo. No later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.

image.name: Vineyard Offshore
image.description: Vineyard Offshore is Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners' U.S. offshore-wind development platform, established in 2022 with federal lease interests held through CI IV. Its disclosed portfolio includes Excelsior Wind within OCS-A 0544 and Vineyard Northeast within OCS-A 0522, as well as other east- and west-coast developments. Vineyard Northeast is the lease and project identity for OCS-A 0522, whose current lessee is Vineyard Northeast LLC; Vineyard Wind 2 is a proposed project of up to 1.2 GW inside that lease, not a separate manager-level company. A 50/50 Avangrid and CIP joint venture won the lease in 2018 and it became effective on April 1, 2019. On January 10, 2022, a CI IV vehicle acquired Avangrid's interest and obtained 100% of the lease rights. Massachusetts provisionally selected 800 MW in September 2024, but Vineyard Offshore withdrew the bid on December 20, 2024 after Connecticut made no offshore-wind selection. The lease remains active, while FAST-41 permitting is paused to April 1, 2027; no PPA, FID, financing close, construction start, lease surrender, sale, CIP exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026. Vineyard Northeast, Vineyard Wind 2, Excelsior Wind and their lease SPVs are consolidated beneath this one platform record; Vineyard Wind 1 remains distinct.

image.name: Anza Renewables
image.description: Anza Renewables is the operating brand of Anza RE, LLC, a U.S. software-enabled procurement, data and analytics platform serving solar and battery-storage developers, independent power producers and other energy buyers. Its tools support module, inverter, storage and transformer sourcing, supplier evaluation and purchase-order execution. The business formally launched from Borrego in September 2022. Borrego contracted to sell all Anza RE, LLC equity to Anza RE Buyer, LLC on February 24, 2023 for US$26.74 million, and Anza announced the completed separation on May 17, 2023 with investment from ECP's Energy Transition Opportunities Fund, Angeleno Group and other investors. ECP and Angeleno continue to list Anza as active; exact stakes, control, the full cap table and the legal closing day are not publicly disclosed. The company is headquartered in Oakland, California and reports more than 80 subscribers and support for over 8 GW of PV and 5 GWh of BESS purchase orders. No later sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

image.name: Braya Renewable Fuels
image.subsector: Renewable diesel and low-carbon fuels refining
image.description: Braya Renewable Fuels is the manager-level renewable-fuels platform operating the Come By Chance refinery in Newfoundland and Labrador through Braya Renewable Fuels (Newfoundland) LP. Cresta Fund Management acquired control in November 2021, while Silverpeak-managed North Atlantic Refining Corp. retained a minority interest. ECP announced a US$300 million preferred-equity investment in April 2023. Exact sponsor percentages, voting rights and holding vehicles are not publicly disclosed, and ECP Fund V is not directly supported for this investment. Commercial renewable-diesel operations began in February 2024; after a temporary 2025 shutdown, operations resumed, and the platform announced its first 100,000-barrel Canadian renewable-diesel sale in June 2026. Braya serves fuel markets in Canada, the United States, Mexico and Europe, while sustainable aviation fuel and green hydrogen or ammonia remain planned rather than confirmed commercial products. No later sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
